name: [🎁] Clicky Keyboard Tower
desc:
Welcome to the original Clicky Keyboard Tower!🤤

Can you climb a tower made of clicky keycaps with every step going clicky click?
Relax and enjoy the various ASMR sounds of keyboard keys.
But be careful… one mistype and you’ll be back at the bottom, starting fresh.😵‍💫

😴 Built for ASMR: soft sounds, smooth physics, satisfying clicks
